crossRefs.note: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold…
a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two…
the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls…
Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,
There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

parallels.note: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows around on the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top…
There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two…
the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two…
the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls…

translations.web: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
translations.bsb: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);
translations.kjv: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
translations.asv: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the pillars.
